blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm whether pure-addition plans (bare 'required argument'/'new schema field'/'callers must') should reach T13; if so, extend the det_gate_rules.py:112 mechanism-of-enforcement regex or correct the commit/routing claim that the pre-gate already fires on all obligation vocabulary.
evidence: det_gate_rules.py:112 regex additive tokens are only `now\s+(?:needs|requires)`, `prerequisite\w*`, `precondition\w*`, `require\w*[^.\n]{0,60}\bbefore\b` — bare 'required', 'callers must', 'must stay in sync/in step', 'new schema field/contract/invariant' are not present
orchestrator.py:286: 'if registry.is_overlay(cid) and cid in triggers and not triggers[cid]:' then 'continue' — a non-firing deterministic overlay is skipped entirely, never routed to the LLM finder

plan_review_T13.md:16-19 new trigger lexicon lists additive phrasings ('adds a required …','callers must','every X must now','must stay in sync/in step','new contract/invariant/schema field') that the unchanged pre-gate does not recognize

criteria_routing.json:1134 trigger claims the router 'remains the applicability authority' while the commit message asserts 'the pre-gate already fires on obligation vocabulary' — true only for the enforcement/`now requires`/`precondition` subset
blocking.finding: The T13 prompt/routing widening to additive obligations is partly unreachable: the unchanged deterministic pre-gate regex ('mechanism-of-enforcement', det_gate_rules.py:112) does not match several additive-only trigger phrasings the widened prompt now advertises ('adds a required …', 'callers must', 'every X must now', 'must stay in sync/in step', 'new contract/invariant/schema field'), and orchestrator.py:286 skips a non-firing overlay before the LLM router sees the plan — so an addition-only plan lacking any enforcement vocabulary never reaches the widened rubric.
scenarios: A plan that adds a required CLI argument or a new schema field to one surface, described without any block/reject/enforce/`now requires`/`precondition` wording — the pre-gate does not fire, T13 is skipped, and the widened additive rubric never runs.
